scope1_onsite_cooling.methodology: IT power MW range x 8760h/yr x 90% utilization x 0.0-2.4 L/kWh (full published Water Usage Effectiveness envelope, Mytton 2021 / Privette et al. 2026) = annual on-site evaporative water use, converted to MGD.
scope1_onsite_cooling.note: Cooling technology (dry/closed-loop, hybrid, or open evaporative) is not disclosed per facility in any PWC public dataset, so this reports the full published WUE envelope rather than an unstated single-technology assumption. scope2_electricity.methodology: facility MW range x 8760h/yr x 90% utilization x 317 gal/MWh (Dominion generation-mix-blended consumption factor, NREL Macknick et al. 2011) = annual consumptive water footprint at the power plant, converted to MGD.

scope3_embodied.methodology: 5%-15% of the operational (Scope 1 + Scope 2) total, anchored to corporate embodied-vs-operational water disclosure ratios (Privette et al. 2026) — not a physical estimate specific to this facility's actual hardware/construction supply chain, which is entirely outside any PWC dataset.
scope3_embodied.note: At least one hyperscale operator has disclosed embodied/supply-chain water exceeding 99% of its total corporate water footprint (Privette et al., AGU Advances, 2026) — that figure reflects a specific company-wide accounting boundary choice (e.g., excluding utility-side power-plant water from its reported Scope 2), not a physical per-facility ratio. It is not used as a default multiplier here; it is flagged as evidence the 5-15% anchor below is a floor, not a ceiling, for facilities with unusually water-light Scope 1/2.

scope_water_footprint.total_note: Envelope sum of independent scope minima and maxima — a conservative bound, not a statistical confidence interval (the three scopes are not assumed to co-vary).

scope2_electricity.methodology: facility MW range x 8760h/yr x 90% utilization x 317 gal/MWh (Dominion generation-mix-blended consumption factor, NREL Macknick et al. 2011) = annual consumptive water footprint at the power plant, converted to MGD.

scope3_embodied.methodology: 5%-15% of the operational (Scope 1 + Scope 2) total, anchored to corporate embodied-vs-operational water disclosure ratios (Privette et al. 2026) — not a physical estimate specific to this facility's actual hardware/construction supply chain, which is entirely outside any PWC dataset.
scope3_embodied.note: At least one hyperscale operator has disclosed embodied/supply-chain water exceeding 99% of its total corporate water footprint (Privette et al., AGU Advances, 2026) — that figure reflects a specific company-wide accounting boundary choice (e.g., excluding utility-side power-plant water from its reported Scope 2), not a physical per-facility ratio. It is not used as a default multiplier here; it is flagged as evidence the 5-15% anchor below is a floor, not a ceiling, for facilities with unusually water-light Scope 1/2.

scope_water_footprint.total_note: Envelope sum of independent scope minima and maxima — a conservative bound, not a statistical confidence interval (the three scopes are not assumed to co-vary).

scope1_onsite_cooling.methodology: IT power MW range x 8760h/yr x 90% utilization x 0.0-2.4 L/kWh (full published Water Usage Effectiveness envelope, Mytton 2021 / Privette et al. 2026) = annual on-site evaporative water use, converted to MGD.
scope1_onsite_cooling.note: Cooling technology (dry/closed-loop, hybrid, or open evaporative) is not disclosed per facility in any PWC public dataset, so this reports the full published WUE envelope rather than an unstated single-technology assumption. scope2_electricity.methodology: facility MW range x 8760h/yr x 90% utilization x 317 gal/MWh (Dominion generation-mix-blended consumption factor, NREL Macknick et al. 2011) = annual consumptive water footprint at the power plant, converted to MGD.

scope3_embodied.methodology: 5%-15% of the operational (Scope 1 + Scope 2) total, anchored to corporate embodied-vs-operational water disclosure ratios (Privette et al. 2026) — not a physical estimate specific to this facility's actual hardware/construction supply chain, which is entirely outside any PWC dataset.
scope3_embodied.note: At least one hyperscale operator has disclosed embodied/supply-chain water exceeding 99% of its total corporate water footprint (Privette et al., AGU Advances, 2026) — that figure reflects a specific company-wide accounting boundary choice (e.g., excluding utility-side power-plant water from its reported Scope 2), not a physical per-facility ratio. It is not used as a default multiplier here; it is flagged as evidence the 5-15% anchor below is a floor, not a ceiling, for facilities with unusually water-light Scope 1/2.

scope_water_footprint.total_note: Envelope sum of independent scope minima and maxima — a conservative bound, not a statistical confidence interval (the three scopes are not assumed to co-vary).

scope2_electricity.methodology: facility MW range x 8760h/yr x 90% utilization x 317 gal/MWh (Dominion generation-mix-blended consumption factor, NREL Macknick et al. 2011) = annual consumptive water footprint at the power plant, converted to MGD.

scope3_embodied.methodology: 5%-15% of the operational (Scope 1 + Scope 2) total, anchored to corporate embodied-vs-operational water disclosure ratios (Privette et al. 2026) — not a physical estimate specific to this facility's actual hardware/construction supply chain, which is entirely outside any PWC dataset.
scope3_embodied.note: At least one hyperscale operator has disclosed embodied/supply-chain water exceeding 99% of its total corporate water footprint (Privette et al., AGU Advances, 2026) — that figure reflects a specific company-wide accounting boundary choice (e.g., excluding utility-side power-plant water from its reported Scope 2), not a physical per-facility ratio. It is not used as a default multiplier here; it is flagged as evidence the 5-15% anchor below is a floor, not a ceiling, for facilities with unusually water-light Scope 1/2.

scope_water_footprint.total_note: Envelope sum of independent scope minima and maxima — a conservative bound, not a statistical confidence interval (the three scopes are not assumed to co-vary).
